disclaimer: Recurring ownership obligations for a non-resident individual owner, current mid-2026. Dates and thresholds change - verify each year with your local accountant. Not tax advice.

obligations.title: Municipal property tax & waste fee
obligations.detail: Annual local property tax (data nedvizhimi imoti) plus waste collection fee (taksa smet), paid to the Sofia municipality. ~0.15-0.45% of tax value.

obligations.title: Annual income tax return (rental)
obligations.detail: Declare rental income; 10% flat tax after the 10% statutory expense deduction. File with the NRA.

obligations.title: Tourist tax & categorisation (if short-let)
obligations.detail: Short lets require municipal categorisation as tourist accommodation and monthly tourist-tax remittance.

obligations.title: IMU first instalment
obligations.detail: First half of the annual municipal property tax on second homes (~0.4-1.06% of cadastral value).

obligations.title: IMU balance
obligations.detail: Balancing second instalment of IMU for the year.

obligations.title: Income tax return / cedolare secca
obligations.detail: Declare rental income under cedolare secca (21% flat, first property). Advance payments may fall in June/November.

obligations.title: CIN compliance (if short-let)
obligations.detail: Display the national CIN code on every listing; meet safety requirements; remit tourist tax to the Comune.

obligations.title: ENFIA property tax
obligations.due: instalments to Feb of next year (often from May)
obligations.detail: Annual property tax based on area and zone value; can be paid in monthly instalments.

obligations.title: E2 + income tax return (rental)
obligations.detail: Declare rental income on form E2 with the annual return; progressive 15-45% rates (2026 scale).

obligations.title: AMA short-let declarations (if short-let)
obligations.detail: Display the AMA number; submit short-stay declarations; meet safety standards. Note the central-Athens AMA freeze until end-2026.

israel_resident.label: Israel (once you are a tax resident again)

obligations.title: Israeli annual tax return
obligations.detail: Report worldwide income including foreign rent; choose the 15% flat track (Sec. 122A) or marginal track + foreign tax credit.

obligations.title: Foreign asset & income disclosure (Amendment 272)
obligations.detail: From 1 Jan 2026, returning residents must report foreign income and assets from day one - even while the income is exempt under the returning-resident relief.
